Keywords: logic, correctness, bug, wrong result, off by one, condition
What to Check: Does the code do what the intent says for real inputs?
Red Flags: Inverted conditions; off-by-one errors; wrong variable; unhandled branch.
How to Verify: Trace one concrete input through the change; run or add a test for it.

Keywords: edge case, boundary, empty, null, zero, max, unicode, timezone
What to Check: Empty, null, zero, maximum, duplicate, unicode and timezone inputs.
Red Flags: Assumes non-empty lists; integer overflow; naive datetime handling.
How to Verify: List boundary inputs and test the riskiest ones.

Keywords: error handling, exception, retry, fallback, timeout, swallow
What to Check: Errors are detected, reported and recovered from deliberately.
Red Flags: Swallowed exceptions; retries without limits; missing timeouts; partial writes on failure.
How to Verify: Force each failure path (fault injection, mocks) and check the outcome.

Keywords: security, injection, xss, auth, authorization, secrets, validation, ssrf, path traversal
What to Check: Untrusted input is validated; authorization is checked; secrets stay secret.
Red Flags: String-built SQL or shell commands; missing authorization checks; secrets in code or logs; user-controlled paths or URLs.
How to Verify: Follow untrusted input to every sink; check the authorization on each new endpoint.

Keywords: concurrency, race, lock, thread, async, deadlock, shared state, idempotency
What to Check: Shared state is protected; operations are idempotent where retried.
Red Flags: Read-modify-write without locks or transactions; awaits missing; unbounded goroutines or threads.
How to Verify: Run with the race detector or stress tests; reason through two interleavings.

Keywords: performance, n+1, loop, query, allocation, complexity, hot path
What to Check: No accidental quadratic work, N+1 queries or large allocations on hot paths.
Red Flags: Queries in loops; loading whole tables; repeated expensive calls.
How to Verify: Count queries in a test; benchmark hot paths that changed.

Keywords: data, migration, schema, backup, irreversible, delete, transaction
What to Check: Data changes are reversible, transactional and safe for existing rows.
Red Flags: Destructive migrations; NOT NULL columns without defaults; no backup; long table locks.
How to Verify: Run the migration on a copy of production-like data; test the rollback.

Keywords: api, breaking change, backward compatible, contract, public interface, version
What to Check: Existing callers keep working, or the break is deliberate and versioned.
Red Flags: Renamed or removed fields; changed defaults; new required parameters.
How to Verify: Search for callers; run contract tests; check the changelog.

Keywords: tests, coverage, assertions, test quality, missing test
What to Check: New behavior and fixed bugs are covered by tests that would fail without the change.
Red Flags: Tests without assertions; tests that mirror the implementation; only happy paths.
How to Verify: Revert the fix locally and confirm the new test fails.

Keywords: readability, naming, clarity, comments, structure, complexity
What to Check: A newcomer can follow the change; names say what things are.
Red Flags: Clever one-liners; misleading names; comments that restate code; deep nesting.
How to Verify: Read it top to bottom once without the author's explanation.

Keywords: logging, metrics, tracing, alerts, observability, monitoring
What to Check: Failures in the new code would be visible in logs, metrics or alerts.
Red Flags: Silent failure paths; logs without context; sensitive data in logs.
How to Verify: Trigger a failure and check what an on-call engineer would see.
